input.title: Halvard Systems Appoints Mara Ellison as Chief Marketing Officer
input.text: Halvard Systems today announced that Mara Ellison has been appointed Chief Marketing Officer, effective December 1, 2026. Ellison was previously SVP Marketing at Brightwell Health.

input.title: Lumen Grid Announces Chief Marketing Officer Transition
input.text: Teo Ravelli will step down as Chief Marketing Officer of Lumen Grid at the end of the year.

input.title: Northwind Robotics Promotes Ines Okafor to Chief Growth Officer
input.text: Ines Okafor, previously SVP Growth, has been promoted to Chief Growth Officer, effective November 15, 2026.

input.title: BRIGHTWELL HEALTH INC: Form 8-K, Item 5.02
input.text: Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers. On November 3, 2026, Dana Whitcombe, the Company's Chief Marketing Officer, notified the Company of her decision to resign, effective November 30, 2026.

input.title: Lindqvist Mobility names Sofie Andersen Chief Marketing Officer
input.text: Stockholm — Lindqvist Mobility AB has named Sofie Andersen as Chief Marketing Officer. She joins on 1 January 2027 from Nordvik Energy, where she was Head of Brand.

input.title: Hartwell & Co. CMO Imogen Pryce to step down
input.text: LONDON — Hartwell & Co. announced that Chief Marketing Officer Imogen Pryce will step down at the end of the year to pursue other opportunities. A search for her successor is under way.

input.title: Maplecrest Foods appoints Daniel Okoye as Chief Growth Officer
input.text: TORONTO — Maplecrest Foods Inc. today appointed Daniel Okoye as Chief Growth Officer, effective immediately. Okoye was previously Vice President, Marketing at Larchmont Brands.

input.title: Quarry Tech confirms Lena Moretti as permanent CMO
input.text: Quarry Tech today confirmed Lena Moretti as Chief Marketing Officer. Moretti has served as interim CMO since June.

input.title: Solano Health announces leadership changes
input.text: Solano Health announced three leadership appointments: Priya Raman as Chief Financial Officer, Marcus Hale as Chief Marketing Officer, and Jun Park as Chief People Officer. All are effective November 1, 2026.

input.title: Brightloom names Ada Chen and Tomas Ruiz co-CMOs
input.text: Brightloom has named Ada Chen and Tomas Ruiz as co-Chief Marketing Officers, effective September 1, 2026.

input.title: 8-K Item 5.02 — Corvex Industries
input.text: Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers. On October 27, 2026, Rachel Voss notified Corvex Industries, Inc. of her decision to resign as Chief Marketing Officer, effective November 14, 2026.

input.title: Reader tip: Atlas Freight may hire a new CMO
input.text: Sources suggest Atlas Freight is close to hiring Gemma Ortiz as its next CMO, though the company has not confirmed.

input.title: Pellucid names Omar Haddad CMO
input.text: Pellucid has named Omar Haddad Chief Marketing Officer. He will lead brand, demand generation and communications.
